bio: Definitely one of the coolest restaurants in town! On the eighth floor of a newly built section of the airport, the incredibly high ceilings, chic interior design, two large glass-fronted wine cabinets and stylish bar are really impressive. The menu features French-inspired cuisine, with an additional lunch deal available daily and brunch served every Sunday. The rooftop terrace has to be the highlight! Tip for motorists: park in Parkhaus 4, south exit....
